stem: Which two characteristics best describe the AWS Cloud's pricing model?
model_answer: Pay-as-you-go (variable, no upfront capex) and elasticity (capacity scales with demand).

stem: Why does the cloud let companies 'go global in minutes'?
model_answer: AWS Regions are spread worldwide, so deploying across them places services close to users with low latency.

stem: Define CapEx vs OpEx in cloud cost terms.
model_answer: CapEx is upfront capital like servers you own; OpEx is recurring operating cost like the monthly cloud bill. Cloud converts CapEx to OpEx.

stem: Name two cost lines the cloud TCO bundles together.
model_answer: Compute and storage (also network, power, cooling, real estate, ops).

stem: What does 'design for failure' mean in AWS architecture?
model_answer: Assume any single component can fail and design redundancy: multi-AZ, health checks, retries, circuit breakers.

stem: Why is loose coupling a Well-Architected principle?
model_answer: Components communicate through defined interfaces (queues, events, APIs) so they can scale and fail independently.

stem: Differentiate public, private and hybrid cloud.
model_answer: Public: provider owns hardware, multi-tenant. Private: single tenant. Hybrid: workloads split across both.

stem: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, who patches the EC2 guest OS?
model_answer: The customer. AWS patches the hypervisor and below (security OF the cloud); the customer patches what runs in their EC2 (security IN the cloud).

stem: For Amazon S3, who is responsible for encryption configuration?
model_answer: The customer chooses encryption. AWS provides the building blocks (SSE-S3, SSE-KMS) but customer enables them.

stem: Define an IAM role and how it differs from an IAM user.
model_answer: A role is an assumable identity used by services or for cross-account access; an IAM user represents a person with long-lived credentials.

stem: State the principle of least privilege.
model_answer: Grant only the permissions required for the task, no more. Start from zero and add as required.

stem: Where should MFA be enabled at minimum?
model_answer: On the root user. Best practice is to also enable MFA on every IAM user.

stem: Which AWS service provides on-demand compliance reports?
model_answer: AWS Artifact. It hosts SOC, ISO, PCI and similar reports.

stem: Distinguish encryption at rest from encryption in transit, and name the AWS service that manages keys for both.
model_answer: At rest protects stored data; in transit protects data on the wire. AWS KMS manages keys for both.

stem: Match the workload to the AWS compute service: 'run my function on demand without managing servers'.
model_answer: AWS Lambda — serverless function execution.

stem: Which EC2 instance family targets memory-bound workloads?
model_answer: The R family (memory-optimised).

stem: Name two managed container services on AWS.
model_answer: ECS and EKS. Both manage cluster orchestration.

stem: Compare S3, EBS and EFS in one line each.
model_answer: S3: object storage over HTTPS. EBS: block storage attached to one EC2 instance. EFS: shared file storage for many instances.

stem: Which S3 storage class trades retrieval latency for the lowest cost?
model_answer: S3 Glacier Deep Archive — retrieval takes hours but cost per GB is the lowest.

stem: Differentiate a security group from a network ACL.
model_answer: Security group: stateful, instance-level. NACL: stateless, subnet-level.

stem: Which AWS service is the global content delivery network?
model_answer: Amazon CloudFront. It caches content at edge locations close to users.

stem: Name a managed NoSQL key-value/document database on AWS.
model_answer: Amazon DynamoDB.

stem: Define an AWS Region and an Availability Zone.
model_answer: A Region is a geographic area; an AZ is a physically separated data centre within a Region. Multi-AZ designs survive single-AZ failures.

stem: Compare On-Demand, Reserved and Spot pricing for EC2.
model_answer: On-Demand: no commitment, full price. Reserved: 1-3yr commit for discount. Spot: spare capacity at up to 90% off; can be reclaimed with 2 minutes notice.

stem: Which discount model fits sustained, predictable EC2 usage?
model_answer: Reserved Instances or Savings Plans (1- or 3-year commitment).

stem: Which AWS Support plan offers 24/7 chat & phone with 1-hour response on production-down?
model_answer: AWS Business Support.

stem: Which AWS service alerts you when spend exceeds a threshold?
model_answer: AWS Budgets. You define thresholds; Budgets sends notifications when they're crossed.

stem: What does AWS Trusted Advisor check?
model_answer: Cost optimisation, security, fault tolerance, performance, and service limits across your account.
